verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own docs describe a self-hosted deployment that runs the review agent inside the customer's own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud, and the FAQ confirms it is offered on the Enterprise tier. That is a first-party, direct capability for this story, but the evidence on it is thin. Missing for 10: deployment and installation details, feature parity with the cloud version, availability outside the Enterprise tier, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosted CodeRabbit runs the CodeRabbit review agent inside your own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud.
On self-hosted CodeRabbit (available for Enterprise), you can opt out of all data retention at any time
